_schema.name: preset label shown to the technician
_schema.negative: negative prompt — the safety terms below are ALWAYS present (brief rule 2.7); aesthetic terms are optional
_schema.control_scale: depth control scale, 0.0–1.0 (below 1.0 = anatomy may go wrong while the pose stays)
_schema.steps: denoising steps, 1–4 — NOT live on Engine B (TensorRT + ControlNet): a different count rebuilds the pipeline (~20 s); keep 1 for shows
_schema.seed_lock: true = fixed seed (calm), false = per-frame seed (flicker texture, Engine B)
_schema.notes: what this preset is for, lighting hints

_safety_negative: nudity, naked, nsfw, sexual, explicit, gore, blood, wounds, mutilation
_aesthetic_negative: ugly, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, blurry, low quality, watermark, text

presets.name: Chrome Sentinel (clean)
presets.prompt: a superhero in a sleek chrome armored suit, glowing blue chest emblem, dramatic rim light, cinematic still, sharp focus
presets.negative: nudity, naked, nsfw, sexual, explicit, gore, blood, wounds, mutilation, ugly, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, blurry, low quality, watermark, text
presets.notes: Clean end of the dials (1 step: more steps rebuild the pipeline on B). Reference preset for pose-legibility checks. Neutral front light.

presets.name: Crimson Colossus
